record.label: Deterministic late-layer propagation program (q10:q15 construction)
record.summary: USER-DIRECTED REOPENING (2026-08-29): the q10:q15 oracle proves capacity (suffix-exact q10:15 = 6.315e-9 protected-40; full exact-q 6.249e-9 all-688), and the per-layer mean truth m_l = E[x_l] is a deterministic functional of the weights, computable OFFLINE to arbitrary precision by seeded sampling with zero sealed-data access. The V13 external constraint is therefore scoped to LEARNED-CORRECTOR SOURCE classes only; the deterministic-construction space is open. Quantitative frame from the oracle receipt: late-q endpoint contributions total ~2.49e-8; reducing per-layer late-q error amplitude to <=0.47x (a 2-2.5x per-step late-layer accuracy improvement at fixed 2^41 deployed cost) yields endpoint <1e-8. Development may use unlimited offline MC truth and freshly sampled MLP instances for cross-instance generalization.
record.terminal_criterion: A deterministic estimator whose full-688 nested evaluation raw MSE is <1e-8 within 2^41 flops, or every child mechanism closed/blocked with receipts.
